scenario.topic: Choose a second-hand car for the community carsharing pool

options.name: 2012 Toyota Corolla LE
options.upside: Known for reliability and widely available parts.
options.concern: Interior space may feel compact for some users.

options.name: 2010 Honda CR-V EX
options.upside: Offers more cargo space and a higher driving position.
options.concern: Slightly lower fuel efficiency compared to sedans.

options.name: 2013 Hyundai Elantra GLS
options.upside: Good fuel economy and modern features for the price.
options.concern: Resale value may be lower than Japanese brands.

options.name: 2011 Ford Escape XLT
options.upside: Offers all-wheel drive and a spacious interior.
options.concern: Maintenance costs can be higher than average.

shared_context: The community carsharing pool needs a reliable second-hand car that seats at least five people, has good fuel efficiency, and moderate maintenance costs. The group will decide among four options that meet these criteria and fit a budget of under $10,000.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Community organizer focused on practical and reliable solutions.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the car is spacious enough for group outings and cargo.

A.reason_for: Reliable and affordable with good fuel efficiency.
A.reason_against: Interior space may feel compact, which concerns me for group use.

B.reason_for: Offers more cargo space and a higher driving position, ideal for community needs.

C.reason_for: Good fuel economy and modern features.
C.reason_against: Less cargo space and resale value concerns make it less ideal.

D.reason_for: Spacious interior and all-wheel drive add versatility.
D.reason_against: Maintenance costs can be higher than average.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Tech worker who values efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
personas.private_goal: Pick the most fuel-efficient car to reduce community expenses.

A.reason_for: Reliable and good fuel efficiency at 30 mpg.

C.reason_for: Best fuel economy at 32 mpg and modern features for the price.

D.reason_against: Lowest fuel efficiency and higher maintenance costs.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Part-time driver and community volunteer who prefers straightforward choices.
personas.private_goal: Choose a car that balances space and ease of maintenance.

B.reason_for: More cargo space and higher driving position improve comfort.

C.reason_against: Lower resale value and less cargo space.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Experienced mechanic and community advocate focused on long-term value.
personas.private_goal: Select a car with low maintenance and good fuel efficiency for sustainability.
